title: Battle of Liegnitz (1760)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Liegnitz (1760)", at revision 1382471782, opens: "The Battle of Liegnitz on 15 August 1760 saw Frederick the Great's Prussian Army defeat the Austrian army under Ernst von Laudon during the Third Silesian War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q701139, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1760 Prussian victory over Austrian army in the Seven Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
